title: Not Worth It
text:
Not Worth It. This ice tray does make pretty clean ice cubes. I find that they sometimes have small bubbles in them, but overall, they are generally pretty clear. The ice cubes are a bit difficult to remove from the tray. You put water into the silicone holder, which has a small hole at the bottom. Under the ice cube there is space for an entire other ice cube, which forms under the silicone tray. These two complete ice cubes are connected through the small hole in the silicone bottom. So, you’re pulling against a lot trying to pry the ice cube out. You can leave it out and let the cubes melt a little. Or you can use warm water to melt them a little to get them out. Neither method is particularly easy or quick. (And the under cube is completely useless and not intended to use.
Sometimes the silicone squares float up as I fill them up, making a less than cube ice cube. The entire tray is an enormous burden to have hanging out in your freezer. It feels like a cheap thin plastic over styrofoam. It takes up quite a bit of room to make 4 ice cubes.

product_metadata.title: Metrokane Rabbit Clear Ice Cube Tray, Gray -
features: This specialty ice tray makes 4 large crystal clear ice cubes, perfect for whiskey or scotch on the rocks
Ice cubes are packed densely to melt slower than regular ice cubes, keeping your drink colder and stronger for longer
An insulated base freezes ice from top to bottom, removing bubbles and impurities that make normal ice look cloudy
Simply fill the blue silicone molds will tap water, freeze, and enjoy with your favorite cocktail or beverage
The plastic ice tray insert is easily removable for quick and hassle-free cleaning
description: At last, the ice you put in your whiskey or cocktail can be as clean and elegant as the drink that it's chilling! The Rabbit Clear Ice Cube Tray is just as easy to use as a regular ice tray, but produces crystal clear large ice cubes with water straight from the tap. The insulated base freezes ice from top to bottom, removing impurities that make other ice cubes appear white and cloudy. Simply fill the blue silicone molds with water, freeze, and enjoy with your favorite cocktail or beverage. The resulting clear ice cubes are packed extra-densely, so they won't melt too quickly and dilute your drink. The plastic ice tray insert removes easily for hassle-free cleaning by hand, while the silicone ice molds are dishwasher safe. Perfect for whiskey or scotch on the rocks, this clear ice cube tray is a tried and true essential for any home bar or kitchen.
